title: WestJet pilots begin strike after labor talks collapse
summary: WestJet has started parking its Boeing 737 jets ahead of a planned strike by its pilots, who are set to walk out on Monday. The pilots are seeking better pay and benefits. WestJet said it had been left with no choice but to park the planes due to the impending strike. The airline's management and union representatives failed to reach an agreement during talks last week. The strike is expected to affect flights across Canada.
